company.shortDescription: Gracenote is an entertainment data and technology provider across Music, Video and Sports.
company.description: Gracenote is an entertainment data and technology provider for Music, Video and Sports.  It powers the top music services, consumer electronics companies, automakers and cable and satellite operators in the world. At its core, Gracenote helps people find, discover and connect with the entertainment they love.
